messages.content: 洛杉磯現在的空氣質量如何？

function.name: plant_biomass
function.description: Calculate the biomass of a plant species in a given area. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

species_name.description: The name of the plant species.

area.description: The area of the forest in square kilometers. This is a float type value.

density.description: The density of the plant species in the area. Default is average global density. This is a float type value.

message.content: 抱歉，我目前無法取得洛杉磯的即時空氣品質資訊。若您需要最新數據，建議查閱官方環保機構（如美國環境保護署 EPA）或使用專門的空氣品質監測網站／App（例如 AirNow、AQICN 等）。如果您想了解洛杉磯一般的空氣品質情況、常見污染源或改善措施，我很樂意提供相關資訊。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "洛杉磯現在的空氣質量如何？" which means "What is the current air quality in Los Angeles?" They want real-time data. We need to check if we have a tool for that. The only tool provided is plant_biomass. That doesn't help. There's no tool for air quality. So we cannot answer with real-time data. According to policy, we should respond that we don't have real-time data. We can provide general info about typical air quality in LA, but not current. We should also ask if they'd like general info. We should not hallucinate. So we respond that we don't have real-time data.
